title: 🎫 Open a Support Ticket
description: Need help with CIPHER? Our support team is here to assist you with technical issues, questions, or any concerns you may have.

fields.name: 🔧 Technical Support
fields.value:
• Installation issues
• Configuration problems
• Performance optimization
• Bug reports
• Feature questions

fields.name: 💬 General Support
fields.value:
• Account questions
• License inquiries
• Usage guidance
• Feature requests
• General questions

fields.name: ⏱️ Response Time
fields.value: Our support team typically responds within **1-2 hours** during business hours. For urgent issues, we're available 24/7.

fields.name: 📋 Before opening a ticket
fields.value:
• Check our FAQ and documentation
• Make sure you have your license key ready
• Describe your issue clearly
• Include any error messages or screenshots

fields.name: 🎯 How to get help?
fields.value: Click the **"🎫 Open Ticket"** button below to create a support ticket. You'll be able to choose the category that best fits your needs.

footer.text: CIPHER Team • We're here to help you
